summary: Comprehensive test suite with strong unit tests covering all core logic (cartesian product, include/exclude rules, validation), workflow structure validation, and integration testing via ACT. Well-organized with clear fixtures, independent tests, and good error path coverage. Minor gaps: only 2 ACT integration cases (though limited by task constraint of max 3 runs), some niche edge cases untested (overlapping includes, special characters in values), and could test more matrix-size scenarios. Would reliably catch most regressions.
